* Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, Object\\-Oriented Programming, and software design, with excellent analytical and problem\\-solving abilities.
* Strong proficiency in Python, with experience developing scalable software applications and/or services.

* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across AI, simulation, product, and software engineering teams and clearly communicate technical concepts.


**Preferred Experience**
* Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React, with experience contributing to full\\-stack web applications.
* Experience with C\\+\\+, Java, or Golang, particularly when integrating existing engineering or simulation software.
* Experience with WebSockets or other real\\-time communication technologies.
* Familiarity with CAE/CAD data, engineering workflows, or simulation software.
* Experience working with AI/ML applications or AI\\-enabled software products.
* Experience with graph databases and graph\\-based data models.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, microservices, event\\-driven architectures, and cloud\\-native design patterns.
* Experience developing and transitioning proof\\-of\\-concept solutions into production systems.

Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

description:

**Organisation:** 
 Narayan Seva Sansthan, Udaipur
 



**Location:** 
 Udaipur, Rajasthan — full\\-time, on\\-site
 



**Reports to:** 
 Project Manager, with functional direction from the Functional Consultant
 



**Engagement:** 
 Permanent, full\\-time
 


 About the organisation
 
 Narayan Seva Sansthan has worked in disability rehabilitation since 1985\\. We run an 1,100\\-bed hospital, have completed close to five lakh free corrective surgeries, and operate through 480\\+ branches with over 1,000 employees. Every service we provide is free of cost. Our founder, Shri Kailash Chandra Agarwal, was conferred the Padma Shri in 2008\\.
 



 Narayan Seva Sansthan, World of Humanity, 1\\-2, Mali Colony, Central Area, Udaipur 313002, Rajasthan \\| www.narayanseva.org
 


 The mandate
 
 We are migrating from a legacy .NET system to ERPNext across HR, Hospital Management, Purchase \\& Stock, Event Management, Manufacturing, School Management, Guest House and Transport. Part of the work has been done by an external partner; the rest will be built in\\-house.
 



 Over three to four years this instance will go through several major ERPNext versions. How you write code now determines whether those upgrades are routine or painful. That is the single thing we care most about.
 


 Responsibilities
 
**Development** 



* Build and maintain customisations in a separate custom app, never by modifying standard apps
* Write server\\-side Python — controllers, hooks, scheduled jobs, whitelisted methods, background workers
* Write client scripts, custom reports (Query and Script), print formats and dashboards
* Build custom DocTypes where a standard DocType genuinely cannot be extended



**Upgrade safety** 



* Choose the least invasive method available for any change, and be able to justify the choice
* Keep fixtures, patches and migrations clean so bench migrate runs without manual intervention
* Test customisations against new versions before upgrade, not after



**Data migration** 



* Build and run migration scripts from the legacy .NET system
* Design validation, error reporting, reconciliation and rollback for every migration run



**Integration** 



* Build integrations with biometric devices, payment gateways, SMS and WhatsApp providers, and hospital systems
* Handle authentication, failure, retry and logging properly



**Performance and stability** 



* Diagnose and fix slow list views, reports and background jobs
* Add indexes, optimise queries, and know when the answer is a database change rather than a code change



**Code discipline** 



* All code in Git, in the institution's repository, with meaningful commits and feature branches
* No code reaches production without review and without a way to roll it back
* Document what you build


 Requirements
 
**Essential** 



* 3–5 years of hands\\-on Frappe/ERPNext development
* Strong Python; MariaDB and SQL; JavaScript
* Have built and deployed at least one custom Frappe app of your own
* Have upgraded a live ERPNext instance across a major version and dealt with what broke
* Git — branching, merging, and a working deployment practice
* Currently based and working in India, and willing to relocate permanently to Udaipur



**Desirable** 



* Frappe UI / Vue, portal pages
* Linux server administration, bench setup, backup and restore
* Experience with HRMS or Healthcare apps
* Having read enough of the ERPNext source to know where things actually happen


 What we offer
 * We are a non\\-profit and our compensation reflects that. What we offer is a system you will build from the ground up and then own — not a ticket queue, not one small module in someone else's product.

Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI\\-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll work across developer tooling, CI/CD, GitOps, and AI\\-assisted development, including MCP servers, agents, evals, and context engineering.

* Automate Engineering Codex controls through CI/CD checks, templates, and policy\\-as\\-code.

**Athenian Project**

Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
   

  

**1\\.1\\.1\\.1**
